versions.changelog:
Initial release of Car Diagnostics & Maintenance Skill.

- Provides troubleshooting for common car symptoms with probable causes and repair cost estimates.
- Offers maintenance schedules with suggested intervals and cost ranges.
- Guides users in deciding between DIY and mechanic repairs.
- Includes a framework for interpreting warning lights and OBD-II codes.
- Helps users make sense of mechanic recommendations and repair estimates.
